conventions.fold: 'all' = pooled over the five router outer folds; 0-4 = router outer fold id
conventions.empty_cell: not applicable or undefined; a ratio's status says which. Never a substitute for 0.
conventions.denominators: every ratio's denominator is explicit. 'routed only' in a label means the denominator excludes abstained rows; otherwise it is the stated population (all rows of the fold / pool unless labelled).
conventions.producers: module paths are relative to shared.stage2.diagnostics

cross_routed_agreement.numerator: rows both routers route to the same pass

labels: rows with the same GLASS and RF state / rows
actual positives of all training rows in the fold / pool

rows in both / rows in either

marginal_precision.denominator: Pass 2 rows the upstream does not flag

labels: reference FP interception rate (intercepted FP / reference FP)

share of Pass 1 positives the reference flags

share of Pass 1 rows the reference flags

states.description: Three-state counts and class composition per router and fold.

columns.arm: router arm: 'glass' = GLASS Router, 'blackbox' = RF Router ('' = not arm-specific)
columns.fold: 'all' = pooled over the five router outer folds; 0-4 = router outer fold id
columns.state: router state: PASS_1_NOT_SUBSCRIBE, PASS_2_SUBSCRIBE or ABSTAIN
columns.rows: rows in the fold (or all rows for 'all')
columns.positive_rate: positives / n (empty when n = 0; see the status column)

ratios.producer: trace.routing_rates; suppression.pass1_population / pass1_suppression_report; contribution.pass2_population / pass2_frozen_contribution / pass2_matched_contribution; overlap.router_reference_agreement / crosstab_summary / boundary_diagnostics
ratios.description: Every count and ratio of the long-format diagnostics, with explicit numerator, denominator, value and status.

columns.section: the step and producing function (see definitions.json tables.ratios.sections)
columns.arm: router arm: 'glass' = GLASS Router, 'blackbox' = RF Router ('' = not arm-specific)
columns.reference: reference flag set: lr = lr.in_stage_f2_cv, ebm = ebm.nested_f2, union = either flags, intersection = both flag; lr_matched / ebm_matched / lr_or_ebm_matched = label-free rate-matched selections; all_pass2 = no reference (all Pass 2 rows)
columns.group: named disagreement population (Step 2D boundary positions); '' elsewhere
columns.score: lr = LR calibrated probability vs its stored threshold; ebm = EBM raw score vs its fold's nested threshold (Step 2D boundary positions); '' elsewhere
columns.fold: 'all' = pooled over the five router outer folds; 0-4 = router outer fold id
columns.metric: metric name; ratios are registered in definitions.json 'metrics'
columns.label: the producing function's label for the metric in this section
columns.denominator: denominator count (empty for count and quantile rows)
columns.value: numerator / denominator for ratios (empty when undefined); the count for count rows; the quantile for quantile rows
columns.status: defined = ratio with a non-zero denominator; undefined_empty_denominator = denominator 0, value left empty (never 0); count = a count; quantile = a distribution quantile

policy_audit.description: Routing-policy claims per router: what the artifacts verify, what is code-level only, declared or not verifiable.

columns.arm: router arm: 'glass' = GLASS Router, 'blackbox' = RF Router ('' = not arm-specific)
columns.status: verified_from_artifacts, evidence_failed, declared, code_level_only or not_verifiable (trace.AUDIT_STATUSES)
columns.evidence: the evidence or the reason it is unavailable

reference_flags.description: The frozen LR / EBM reference flags (and their union / intersection) used by every router-to-reference comparison.

columns.reference: reference flag set: lr = lr.in_stage_f2_cv, ebm = ebm.nested_f2, union = either flags, intersection = both flag; lr_matched / ebm_matched / lr_or_ebm_matched = label-free rate-matched selections; all_pass2 = no reference (all Pass 2 rows)
columns.score_space: score space the flag is defined in
columns.threshold: stored scalar threshold (empty for fold-nested decisions: see MANIFEST.json upstream_operating_points)
columns.selection: how the threshold / decisions were selected (disclosed)
columns.fold_plan: the reference's fold plan relative to the routers' outer folds

pass2_breakdown.description: Pass 2 TP / FP split by which frozen references flag them.

columns.arm: router arm: 'glass' = GLASS Router, 'blackbox' = RF Router ('' = not arm-specific)
columns.fold: 'all' = pooled over the five router outer folds; 0-4 = router outer fold id
columns.tp_both: Pass 2 TP flagged by LR and EBM
columns.fp_both: Pass 2 FP flagged by LR and EBM
columns.tp_lr_only: Pass 2 TP flagged by LR only
columns.fp_lr_only: Pass 2 FP flagged by LR only
columns.tp_ebm_only: Pass 2 TP flagged by EBM only
columns.fp_ebm_only: Pass 2 FP flagged by EBM only

common_population.description: The common eligible population (rows neither router routed to Pass 1) and what it excludes.

columns.fold: 'all' = pooled over the five router outer folds; 0-4 = router outer fold id
columns.positives: actual positives in the fold / pool
columns.glass_remainder_rows: rows GLASS did not route to Pass 1
columns.rf_remainder_rows: rows RF did not route to Pass 1
columns.common_rows: rows neither router routed to Pass 1 (common eligible population)
columns.common_positives: actual positives in the common eligible population
columns.glass_pass2_in_common: GLASS Pass 2 rows inside the common population
columns.rf_pass2_in_common: RF Pass 2 rows inside the common population
columns.glass_pass2_outside_common: GLASS Pass 2 rows RF routed to Pass 1 (excluded)
columns.rf_pass2_outside_common: RF Pass 2 rows GLASS routed to Pass 1 (excluded)

matched_selection.description: The label-free rate-matched reference selections: K, cut, tie block and tie-broken rows per arm, model and fold.

columns.arm: router arm: 'glass' = GLASS Router, 'blackbox' = RF Router ('' = not arm-specific)
columns.reference: reference flag set: lr = lr.in_stage_f2_cv, ebm = ebm.nested_f2, union = either flags, intersection = both flag; lr_matched / ebm_matched / lr_or_ebm_matched = label-free rate-matched selections; all_pass2 = no reference (all Pass 2 rows)
columns.model: the reference model ranked (lr or ebm)
columns.fold: 'all' = pooled over the five router outer folds; 0-4 = router outer fold id
columns.target_count: K = the arm's Pass 2 rows in the fold's common eligible population
columns.selected_rows: rows selected (always K): the K highest scores, ties broken by the label-free tie-break rule (MANIFEST.json analysis_settings)
columns.exact: true when no tie straddles the cut
columns.tie_block: rows sharing the K-th score (1 = no tie)
columns.strict_count: rows strictly above the tied block (strict bound, <= K)
columns.inclusive_count: rows including the whole tied block (inclusive bound, >= K)
columns.tie_broken_rows: rows chosen from the tied block by the tie-break rule

contingency.description: Router state x reference flag: rows, positives and negatives.

columns.arm: router arm: 'glass' = GLASS Router, 'blackbox' = RF Router ('' = not arm-specific)
columns.reference: reference flag set: lr = lr.in_stage_f2_cv, ebm = ebm.nested_f2, union = either flags, intersection = both flag; lr_matched / ebm_matched / lr_or_ebm_matched = label-free rate-matched selections; all_pass2 = no reference (all Pass 2 rows)
columns.fold: 'all' = pooled over the five router outer folds; 0-4 = router outer fold id
columns.state: router state: PASS_1_NOT_SUBSCRIBE, PASS_2_SUBSCRIBE or ABSTAIN
columns.reference_flag: true = the reference flags the row

crosstab.description: GLASS state x RF state cells with label composition and reference flags.

columns.fold: 'all' = pooled over the five router outer folds; 0-4 = router outer fold id
columns.positive_rate: positives / n (empty when n = 0; see the status column)
columns.share: n / rows in the fold group (registered cross_cell_share)
columns.lr_flags: rows in the cell the lr reference flags
columns.lr_flagged_positives: positives in the cell the lr reference flags
columns.ebm_flags: rows in the cell the ebm reference flags
columns.ebm_flagged_positives: positives in the cell the ebm reference flags
columns.union_flags: rows in the cell the union reference flags
columns.union_flagged_positives: positives in the cell the union reference flags
columns.intersection_flags: rows in the cell the intersection reference flags
columns.intersection_flagged_positives: positives in the cell the intersection reference flags

pass2_cross_router.description: Pass 2 positives and negatives both routers / one router flag, overall and unique relative to each reference.

columns.reference: reference flag set: lr = lr.in_stage_f2_cv, ebm = ebm.nested_f2, union = either flags, intersection = both flag; lr_matched / ebm_matched / lr_or_ebm_matched = label-free rate-matched selections; all_pass2 = no reference (all Pass 2 rows)
columns.fold: 'all' = pooled over the five router outer folds; 0-4 = router outer fold id
columns.glass_unique_tp: GLASS Pass 2 positives the reference does not flag
columns.rf_unique_tp: RF Pass 2 positives the reference does not flag
columns.shared_tp: of those, positives both routers flag
columns.glass_only_tp: unique positives GLASS flags and RF does not
columns.rf_only_tp: unique positives RF flags and GLASS does not
columns.glass_unique_fp: GLASS Pass 2 negatives the reference does not flag
columns.rf_unique_fp: RF Pass 2 negatives the reference does not flag
columns.shared_fp: of those, negatives both routers flag
columns.glass_only_fp: unique negatives GLASS flags and RF does not
columns.rf_only_fp: unique negatives RF flags and GLASS does not
columns.glass_only_tp_in_rf_pass1: GLASS-only unique positives RF routed to Pass 1
columns.glass_only_tp_in_rf_abstain: GLASS-only unique positives RF abstained on
columns.rf_only_tp_in_glass_pass1: RF-only unique positives GLASS routed to Pass 1
columns.rf_only_tp_in_glass_abstain: RF-only unique positives GLASS abstained on
columns.pool_positives: positives neither reference-flagged nor in either router's Pass 1

signal_availability.description: Which pre-routing signals the artifacts persist, and which overlap analyses are therefore unavailable.

columns.arm: router arm: 'glass' = GLASS Router, 'blackbox' = RF Router ('' = not arm-specific)
columns.basis: artifact, code, none or invalid population
columns.rows: rows the signal covers (empty when unavailable)

score_conditional.description: Router state x label-free score stratum: label composition, calibrated expectations and reference flags.

columns.arm: router arm: 'glass' = GLASS Router, 'blackbox' = RF Router ('' = not arm-specific)
columns.stratifier: lr (LR calibrated probability deciles), ebm_raw (EBM raw score deciles) or lr_x_ebm (3 x 3 joint grid); always within the router outer fold
columns.fold: 'all' = pooled over the five router outer folds; 0-4 = router outer fold id
columns.stratum: bin index within the fold (merged edges: see the known limitations); pooled rows sum bin k of every fold
columns.state: router state: PASS_1_NOT_SUBSCRIBE, PASS_2_SUBSCRIBE or ABSTAIN
columns.positive_rate: positives / n (empty when n = 0; see the status column)
columns.expected_lr_calibrated: sum of LR calibrated OOF probabilities over the rows
columns.expected_ebm_calibrated: sum of EBM calibrated OOF probabilities over the rows
columns.low_support: true when n < the minimum support

stratum_contrasts.description: Positive-rate differences between router states within a stratum (defined only where both states have minimum support).

columns.arm: router arm: 'glass' = GLASS Router, 'blackbox' = RF Router ('' = not arm-specific)
columns.fold: 'all' = pooled over the five router outer folds; 0-4 = router outer fold id
columns.contrast: pass1 - abstain, pass2 - abstain or pass2 - pass1
columns.difference_pp: 100 x (positive rate of the first state - of the second)

observed_expected.description: Observed vs expected positives for the router states and the named disagreement populations (descriptive; not tests).

columns.fold: 'all' = pooled over the five router outer folds; 0-4 = router outer fold id
columns.positive_rate: positives / n (empty when n = 0; see the status column)
columns.expected_lr_calibrated: sum of LR calibrated OOF probabilities over the group
columns.expected_ebm_calibrated: sum of EBM calibrated OOF probabilities over the group
columns.expected_stratified_lr: sum over the group's rows of their (fold, lr stratum) cell's observed positive rate (internal standardisation on the same labels)
columns.expected_stratified_ebm_raw: sum over the group's rows of their (fold, ebm_raw stratum) cell's observed positive rate (internal standardisation on the same labels)
columns.expected_stratified_lr_x_ebm: sum over the group's rows of their (fold, lr_x_ebm stratum) cell's observed positive rate (internal standardisation on the same labels)

chance_baselines.description: Arithmetic chance expectations for unique positives and Pass 1 interceptions (not statistical tests).

columns.setting: frozen_pass2_unique (unique flags vs rows not reference-flagged and not the arm's own Pass 1), pass1_random_veto (Pass 1 interceptions vs the reference flags), matched_pass2_unique (common eligible rows outside the K-matched reference)
columns.arm: router arm: 'glass' = GLASS Router, 'blackbox' = RF Router ('' = not arm-specific)
columns.reference: reference flag set: lr = lr.in_stage_f2_cv, ebm = ebm.nested_f2, union = either flags, intersection = both flag; lr_matched / ebm_matched / lr_or_ebm_matched = label-free rate-matched selections; all_pass2 = no reference (all Pass 2 rows)
columns.fold: 'all' = pooled over the five router outer folds; 0-4 = router outer fold id
columns.flags: the router's rows in the setting
columns.pool_rate: pool_positives / pool_rows (empty when the pool is empty)
columns.expected_positives: flags x pool_rate (arithmetic, not a test)
columns.observed_positives: the router's actual positives in the setting

model_disagreement.description: How much LR and EBM already disagree (frozen, and at each arm's matched K), next to the routers' unique positives.

columns.setting: frozen (the stored operating points) or matched_same_k (LR / EBM re-cut at the arm's K on the common eligible population)
columns.arm: router arm: 'glass' = GLASS Router, 'blackbox' = RF Router ('' = not arm-specific)
columns.fold: 'all' = pooled over the five router outer folds; 0-4 = router outer fold id
columns.lr_only_tp: positives LR flags and EBM does not
columns.ebm_only_tp: positives EBM flags and LR does not
columns.lr_only_fp: negatives LR flags and EBM does not
columns.ebm_only_fp: negatives EBM flags and LR does not
columns.ebm_minus_lr_tp: EBM TP - LR TP at the same K
columns.ebm_only_tp_expected_from_pool: EBM-only flags x the positive rate of the rows LR does not select (arithmetic)
columns.router_unique_tp_vs_lr: the arm's Pass 2 TP the matched LR selection misses (Step 2C)
columns.router_unique_tp_vs_ebm: the arm's Pass 2 TP the matched EBM selection misses (2C)

validation.producer: RouterTrace.checks; each view's boundary extractor checks
validation.description: Every trace check (T1-T7) and boundary extractor check, with its result.
